description: This PHP class defines EmbeddedURLForVimeo, a component responsible for validating and generating embed URLs for Vimeo videos based on provided URL strings. It extends an abstract base class and contains regex patterns and logic to extract Vimeo video IDs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForVimeo
classes.description: A class for handling Vimeo embedded video URL validation and conversion from standard URLs to embedded URLs.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Generates and returns an embedded Vimeo URL if the input URL matches known Vimeo URL patterns; throws an exception if the URL is invalid.
